Payable address receiving marketing ETH; also used as an access control gate.

External ERC20 transfer entry point delegating to _transfer.
External ERC20 transferFrom entry point delegating to _transfer and _approve.

Core transfer logic applying wallet limits, fees, swap-and-liquify and ETH distribution.
Swaps contract tokens for ETH via the router; guarded by lockTheSwap.

Transfers contract ETH balance to the marketing address.
External function allowing marketing address to trigger a token to ETH swap.
External function allowing marketing address to trigger ETH transfer to the fee address.

Sets marketing and liquidity fee values; no access control applied.

Caller-controlled address used for transfers, approvals and access checks.

Division by (_marketingFee + _liquidityFee) in swapAndLiquify which can be zero and revert.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the from address into _transfer via transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender in transferFrom allowance handling.
msg.sender is the owner of the allowance set in approve.
msg.sender flows into _transfer as caller-controlled address.
manualSwap authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to the marketing address.
manualSend authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to the marketing address.
setSwapAmount authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to deploy/marketing addresses.
block.timestamp is used as the router swap deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
transfer delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates execution to _transfer.
_transfer conditionally calls swapAndLiquify when contract token balance exceeds swapAmount.
_transfer conditionally calls sendETHToFee on accumulated ETH.
_transfer finishes by calling _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to move balances.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens to ETH.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity with the derived amounts.
manualSwap calls swapTokensForEth with the contract balance.
manualSend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee when takeFee is false.
_tokenTransfer calls restoreAllFee after the standard transfer.
_transfer calls restoreAllFee after transferring.
_transferStandard writes the _balances mapping for sender, recipient and contract.
setTaxes writes _marketingFee.
setTaxes writes _liquidityFee.
setTaxes writes _previousMarketingFee.
setTaxes writes _previousLiquidityFee.
setMaxWalletAmount writes _maxWalletAmount after bounds checks.
setSwapAmount writes swapAmount.
removeAllFee zeroes _marketingFee and caches the previous value.
removeAllFee zeroes _liquidityFee and caches the previous value.
restoreAllFee restores _marketingFee from _previousMarketingFee.
restoreAllFee restores _liquidityFee from _previousLiquidityFee.
_transfer reads tradingOpen to gate non-exempt transfers.
_transfer reads the bots mapping when applying buy fees.
_transfer reads uniswapV2Pair to distinguish buys and sells.
_transfer reads _maxWalletAmount for the buy wallet cap.
sendETHToFee reads _marketingAddress as the ETH recipient.
swapTokensForEth executes the external router swap with zero amountOutMin.
addLiquidity executes the external payable addLiquidityETH call with zero minimums.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to the marketing address.
swapAndLiquify divides by (_marketingFee + _liquidityFee), which can be zero when fees are removed.
The external router swap call can transfer tokens/ETH to this contract and re-enter the _transfer swap path.
Sending ETH to an untrusted payable address can invoke receive() and re-enter the transfer logic.
The external addLiquidityETH call interacts with the pair and can re-enter _transfer before fees are restored.
